**Developing Mesos Deployer**

technical_and_design_decisions: Target Java 17+ environment leveraging Spring Boot and Spring Cloud Data Flow (s-c-d) project standards.
Implement Mesos deployment support using the Spring Cloud Deployer SPI for Apache Mesos/Marathon integration.
Utilize Spring Shell's completion provider architecture (JLine) to implement interactive shell tab completion.
Enhance Spring Cloud Stream property path parsing using SpEL (Spring Expression Language) to support dot-notation traversal for Tuple and JSON objects.
Extract shared Redis test fixtures into a standalone repository/artifact to enable cross-project reuse without circular dependencies.
assumptions: Development work will be performed by a single experienced senior Java developer.
Existing build pipelines, CI/CD infrastructure, and repository structures are operational.
Research/spike stories (Kafka 0.9, Lattice deployment) will deliver technical findings, prototype code, and documentation rather than production-grade implementations.
Target execution environments (Mesos cluster, Lattice testbed, Kafka 0.9 broker) are available for integration testing.

activities.activity_description: Design backend REST APIs to aggregate execution status of nested job steps and implement front-end UI progress bar component for composed jobs.
Implement logic to track state of stopped/failed composed jobs and allow triggering a restart from the last successful execution point.
Investigate Kafka 0.9 client API changes, test compatibility with s-c-d binder implementations, and document recommended improvements.
Explore bootstrapping s-c-d on Lattice for bare metal deployments, create deployment scripts/templates, and document findings.

activities.activity_name: Dot-delimited Syntax for Tuple and JSON (U5)
activities.activity_description: Implement dot-delimited property resolution in Spring Cloud Stream to support accessing nested JSON and Tuple properties seamlessly.

activities.activity_name: Shell Tab Completion for Modules and Options (U6)
activities.activity_description: Integrate auto-completion providers into s-c-d shell to complete registered modules, options, and parameters dynamically.
Develop Spring Cloud Deployer implementation for Apache Mesos/Marathon to manage application lifecycle (launch, scale, terminate).
Extract the Redis JUnit Rule into a standalone repository/library and update build configurations for multi-project consumption.
Perform end-to-end verification across implemented features and compile documentation updates for the release increment.
